answer: Each agent must lease a unique knoll of scarce routing identity; the lease cannot be subdivided and rent is burned every epoch. Spot checks drop a one-time yarrow code that only that slot may redeem. If two slots redeem from the same host or key, the protocol treats them as a reef of clones and burns every linked deposit. The attacker pays scarce-slot prices plus continuous rent, then loses the whole reef if any probe collides.
